categories.main_business_segments: Sunfly Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four segments: electrical complete sets equipment, smart city integrated services, new energy business, and new materials business. The electrical equipment segment includes high and low voltage complete sets used in industrial and civil applications. Smart city services cover smart lighting, smart policing, smart transportation, and intelligent building solutions. The new energy segment focuses on hydrogen energy, including upstream hydrogen production equipment and downstream hydrogen vehicle operations, while the new materials segment develops fire suppression materials and high-performance nano lithium battery materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as PLC communication modules, AIOT, edge computing, and cloud computing for smart city solutions. In hydrogen energy, it focuses on alkaline water electrolysis technology for green hydrogen production with high purity and efficiency. The electrical equipment manufacturing involves modular design, intelligent control systems, and integration of hardware and software for energy management. New materials development includes microcapsule self-responsive fire suppression and nano lithium battery materials synthesized via flame spray pyrolysis.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include real estate developers like Country Garden Group, industrial sectors such as petroleum, petrochemical, power, metallurgy, and infrastructure projects including municipal engineering, rail transit, and data centers. The company serves markets in smart city infrastructure, new energy logistics, and industrial power distribution. It is expanding into energy, infrastructure, public buildings, transportation, and logistics sectors to diversify away from real estate dependence.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering 29 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities. Major regional markets include Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. Key operational hubs and subsidiaries are located in Shandong Province (headquarters), Guangdong Province (Foshan), and other strategic locations such as Shenzhen and Nanjing.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sunfly Intelligent Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures and supplies electrical equipment and hydrogen production devices (midstream), and provides integrated smart city services and hydrogen vehicle operations (downstream). The company also engages in new materials production supporting energy storage and battery manufacturing, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in smart energy and infrastructure.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on the 'Intelligent + Dual Carbon' development strategy, emphasizing smart power systems and clean energy. R&D priorities include smart electrical components, edge computing gateways for smart lighting, power load optimization, arc fault detection algorithms, and hydrogen energy technologies. It is advancing research in photovoltaic-hydrogen storage integration, intelligent power distribution, and new materials innovation to support energy transition and digital infrastructure.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electrical complete sets, smart city hardware and software solutions, hydrogen production equipment, and new materials. The company also earns income from service contracts in smart city projects and hydrogen vehicle operation platforms. Sales channels include direct sales and bidding, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance or project completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company holds a strong market position in China’s electrical equipment and smart city sectors, recognized as a high-tech enterprise with strategic partnerships with industry leaders like Schneider, ABB, and Siemens. It is a key supplier to major projects and has certifications and awards that reinforce its competitive standing. The company is transitioning to diversify its portfolio to reduce reliance on the real estate sector and strengthen its presence in new energy and smart infrastructure markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.455 billion, a 27.32% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss of RMB 132.12 million, though losses narrowed significantly compared to 2023. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 2.85 billion, down 12.95% year-over-year. Despite current losses, the company is undergoing strategic transformation with growth in new energy and new materials segments, aiming for sustainable profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sunfly Intelligent Technology emphasizes integrated smart power solutions combining hardware, software, and services to ensure reliable, safe, and efficient power distribution. Its hydrogen energy products offer high purity and energy efficiency, supporting green energy transition. The company’s smart city solutions leverage cutting-edge technologies like AIOT and edge computing for real-time data processing and intelligent control. Its new materials provide innovative fire suppression and advanced battery components, enabling import substitution and enhanced performance. The company’s broad product portfolio and national sales and service network provide comprehensive, customized solutions that differentiate it in the market.
